answer: A durable defense is bonded attestation: each agent identity locks a stake bond that is slashed if it vouches for a fake peer, so forging a thousand identities costs a thousand bonds. Newcomers enter only through a bridge of referrals from established agents — like light through a prism, one identity refracts into many claims, but only the original beam carries stake. A single ember of reputation takes weeks of honest work to earn, so a Sybil swarm burns capital faster than it gains influence.
